types.description: Protective cap for R. STAHL 8570/12 SolConeX 16 A four-pole (3P+PE) plug

document.title: R. STAHL Presa da muro, connettore 8570/11, 8570/12 - Istruzioni per l'uso
document.pages: p.14 s.12 accessory table (protective cap 8570002140 for 16 A 4-pole connector); p.7 8570/12-4.. = 16 A 3P+PE; p.9 s.7.2 threaded cap protects plug pins

modelingNotes: Manufacturer accessory table (page 14, section 12) explicitly lists order number 8570002140 as the protective cap (Cappuccio di protezione) 'per connettore 16 A a 4 poli' (for the 16 A four-pole connector). Order number preserved exactly; no successor, abbreviation or extra-low-voltage exclusion is applied.

Distinct from the sibling caps: 8570001140 is the 3-pole cap (marked 'non adatto per versione a bassissima tensione' / not for extra-low-voltage) and 8570003140 is the 5-pole cap. That extra-low-voltage exclusion belongs to the 3-pole cap only and is NOT transferred here.

Mechanical threaded protective cap with zero electrical terminals, pins, bonding or circuit functions. Per page 9 section 7.2 it screws onto the 8570/12 plug's contact end to protect the pins from dirt when the plug is unmated. It does not terminate, bond or short any pin.
'4-pole' equals 3P+PE: page 7 identifies the 8570/12-4.. series as 16 A, 3P + earth (four contacts).

The manufacturer does not assign the cap a separate IP rating, material, thread size or Ex marking in the accessory table. Sealing/ingress and Ex suitability of the capped assembly depend on the installed plug and application review; this model asserts none.

connectionCoverage.notes: Mechanical protective cap; no electrical terminals, pins, bonding or circuit functions. Fit and installed environmental protection depend on the specified 4-pole 16 A R. STAHL 8570/12 plug and its assembly.
